body: Thinking about this further, aliases should be unique per application. If you have duplicate class names you should still make unique aliases for them.

Maybe we shouldn't use simplified aliases for plugin tables. If we register two tables within two plugins: PluginFoo\BazTable and PluginBar\BazTable, should we access to there tables with TableRegistry by aliases like: PlugFoo.Baz and PlugBar.Baz. But now, using alias Baz without plugin name is ambiguous. Force to using Plugin.Table aliases for models within plugins make sure they are unique.

Requiring aliases to always contain the plugin creates a few other problems. Mostly around properties. `.` cannot be used in an identifier meaning both entity properties and association properties on tables will not work. Stripping the plugin prefix on properties just moves the current problem. I would rather we don't have half working solutions personally.
